edges.title: Product
edges.position: KC's current product is thought leadership delivered through wellness events, mastermind dinners, podcasting, content, and emerging speaking. She is a mentor and thought leader, not a coach and not an educator.
edges.compass: Follow the woman who lives the standard. Events, podcast, content, and speaking all point to one discipline-first life.

edges.title: People
edges.offer_name: High-earning women who need the standard
edges.position: KC serves high-earning, health-curious, undisciplined women in SoCal who know something has to change but do not know where to start. The primary persona is Alina.
edges.compass: Alina: 35, SoCal, good salary, health-conscious but undisciplined, holistic-leaning, and awkward around cannabis.

edges.title: Purpose
edges.position: KC exists to help women reclaim cognitive longevity, hormonal health, physical health, and mental health through lifestyle discipline, weighted heavily toward fitness and discipline.
edges.compass: The point is not to change every woman. The point is to make the better way visible enough that excuses get harder to defend.

edges.title: Promise
edges.position: The brand promise is No Excuses. KC will not sell the shortcut. She will be the voice that makes Alina do the work.
edges.compass: No shortcuts. No GLP-1 identity. No passive wellness. No excuses.

edges.title: Personality
edges.position: KC's personality is Hero and Ruler tied for primary, Magician as transformation, and Cannabis Outlaw as the category edge. She is rough-edged, plainspoken, unsentimental, tough-love, and demanding.
edges.compass: Jocko-energy with a SoCal mom's voice. Beautiful, sexy, strong, and present without becoming girly.
